scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:bg: npm run dev:bg:server && npm run dev:bg:frontend && echo 'Started in background. Logs: logs/'
scripts.dev:bg:server: mkdir -p logs && nohup npm run dev:server > logs/server.log 2>&1 &
scripts.dev:bg:frontend: mkdir -p logs && nohup npm run dev:frontend > logs/frontend.log 2>&1 &
scripts.dev:stop: lsof -ti:${PORT:-3001} | xargs -r kill -9; lsof -ti:${VITE_PORT:-5173} | xargs -r kill -9; echo 'Stopped'
scripts.prod: concurrently -n server,frontend -c blue,green "npm run prod:server" "npm run prod:frontend"
scripts.prod:bg: npm run prod:bg:server && npm run prod:bg:frontend && echo 'Production started in background. Logs: logs/'
scripts.prod:bg:server: mkdir -p logs && nohup npm run prod:server > logs/prod-server.log 2>&1 &
scripts.prod:bg:frontend: mkdir -p logs && nohup npm run prod:frontend > logs/prod-frontend.log 2>&1 &
scripts.prod:stop: lsof -ti:${PORT:-3001} | xargs -r kill -9; lsof -ti:${VITE_PREVIEW_PORT:-4173} | xargs -r kill -9; echo 'Production stopped'
scripts.plugins:install: for dir in plugins/*/; do (cd "$dir" && pnpm install); done
scripts.plugins:build: for dir in plugins/*/; do (cd "$dir" && pnpm build); done
scripts.plugins:build:zip: for dir in plugins/*/; do (cd "$dir" && pnpm build:zip); done
